meaning: noun: the drowsy, contented feeling you get after a big meal
noun: the ability to improvise a creative solution out of nothing
adj.: cozy, convivial, and contented; the warmth of togetherness
noun: the leisurely conversation that lingers at the table after a meal
noun: a beer you drink outside, especially on the first warm day of the year
verb: to make something worse in the process of trying to improve it
noun: the interplay of sunlight filtering through leaves
noun: inner strength, stoic determination, and resilience in the face of adversity
adj./adv.: not too much, not too little — just the right amount
noun: a melancholic longing for something loved and now gone
noun: an ache for distant places; the opposite of homesickness
noun: the quality of being cozy, convivial, and belonging — felt rather than described
noun: finding beauty in imperfection, transience, and incompleteness
noun: the disorienting feeling of being a foreigner; being out of your element
noun: a deep world-weariness born from comparing how the world is to how it ought to be
phrase: it will all work out — an Icelandic expression of calm optimism
